records.failureSummary: Slice-1 parseCsvLine is implemented in src/csv.mjs exactly as designed: a named ES module export that returns [] immediately when typeof line !== 'string' (no throw for null, undefined, 123, true, {}), otherwise returns line.split(','), preserving each field's leading/trailing whitespace and producing empty-string fields for consecutive or trailing commas. No quote parsing, escaping, trim, or new dependencies were added, honoring the slice scope. Build (node --check src/csv.mjs) and lint both exit 0. All slice-1 acceptance criteria verifiably pass. The full suite shows 1 pass / 2 fail; both failures are explicitly out-of-scope for slice-1 (quoted-field parsing FR-2 and empty-line guard FR-4), previously documented as known risks by design task T2 and deferred to their dedicated slices, so no in-scope work remains.
